modelFields.coverageLabel: Published 120-credit named baseline with reviewed outside awards and retained Liberty courses; individual admission and transfer awards remain separate.
rulesNotes: A 120-credit baseline: 36 unique general education + 12 major foundations + 39 psychology core + 9 addictions/recovery cognate + 24 free electives.
BIOL 102 and PSYC 101 also satisfy natural/social science. These six credits are owned by major foundations and counted once; the capstone/internship alternative is counted once.
UNIV 104 retains the printed three-credit case. An individually approved zero-credit determination can release those hours for electives within the published 18–27-credit range; no waiver is assumed.
Do not automatically remove RLGN 104 at 45 transfer credits or THEO 104 at 60 transfer credits. The source permits those waivers, but this ledger retains both courses until individual evaluation.

Four distinct reviewed Study.com business awards and four distinct reviewed Sophia awards fill eight unrestricted three-credit free-elective allocations. Each receiving course is absent from the fixed degree ledger.
The 60-credit major/foundations/cognate component requires at least 15 Liberty credits (25%); the degree also requires at least 30 Liberty credits overall and 30 upper-level credits.

PSYC 491 is offered online. Its introductory psychology and PSYC 255 prerequisites, minimum-C prerequisite grades, junior/senior standing and 18 completed PSYC-credit requirement remain applicable. The PSYC 440 chain belongs to PSYC 498 and is not a prerequisite for this capstone.

unresolved.message: Submit official records for Liberty’s individual transfer evaluation, admission/catalog rights, home-state general-education additions, minimum grades and duplicate-learning check.

The retained three-credit UNIV 104 allocation is 36 unique general education + 60 major/foundations/cognate + 24 unrestricted free electives = 120. The 60-credit major/cognate residency denominator requires 15 Liberty credits. No transfer-triggered waiver is assumed.

Outside-course equivalencies must be sourced separately; a university requirement is not evidence that a particular accelerated course transfers. The selected baseline outside options use their separately reviewed current provider identities and exact published online awards.

Before registration, record accepted prerequisite credit and select available online sections. Meet PSYC 491’s minimum-C prerequisite, junior/senior standing and 18 completed PSYC-credit requirements; personal eligibility and future section availability remain unconfirmed.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.detail: Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 retained
obligations.notes: This baseline retains three-credit UNIV 104 and 24 unrestricted free-elective credits within the published 18–27-credit range. An individually approved zero-credit determination can change this allocation; no waiver is assumed.

obligations.title: PSYC 491 registration
obligations.notes: Before the online capstone, meet the published minimum-C prerequisite grades, junior/senior standing and 18 successfully completed PSYC credits. No personal grade or standing is assumed.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: 12 major foundational + 39 psychology core + 9 addictions/recovery cognate = 60; 25% requires 15 Liberty credits.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
